[[Choker of Insight]] | previous = [[Piece Of A Bigger Picture]] }} ==Objectives== Calm the pearl and return to Hydromancer Finnigan in the SI:7 Outpost on Balor afterwards. * [[Abysstide Siren|Subsided the Pearl's wrath]] ==Description== It is done. Quickly, take the crystal and hold it near the shattered pearl, on the northwestern islands. The crystal's own harmonious energy should be enough to soothe the pearl's raging energy. Beware of what might happen; tidal magic is unpredictable and untamed. ==Rewards== You will be able to choose one of these rewards: *[[Hydromancer Cowl]] *[[Choker of Insight]] You will also receive: * [[Pearlescent Shard]] * 3100 XP *+100 [[reputation]] with [[Kul Tiras (faction)|Kul Tiras]] ==Progress== All of this is more than puzzling, yet the situation calls for action, not speculation. ==Completion== Naga, you say?! This is truly bad news. If these slithering demons are behind this phenomenon, then I dare not think what their true intentions are. For now we have thwarted their ambitions. However, I do wonder, has this pearl been here all along? If so, was it always broken? And if not, why was it brought here; and by whom? The naga or the murlocs? Many unanswered questions still lie before us and none of them seem to be easily answered. Either way, I must thank you for your assistance. Our findings today helped me gain a better understanding of Balor's unending storm. Once I return to Davenburg, I will send notice to the Council of Tides in Boralus about the pearl, as well as the naga's involvement in all of this. With their ongoing incursions onto Kul Tiras, I am afraid this won't be the last we've seen of them. Please, take this as humble compensation for your deeds. ==Progression== # {{questlong|Alliance|29|Ceaseless Storms}} # {{questlong|Alliance|30|Piece Of A Bigger Picture}} # {{questlong|Alliance|30|Calming The Tempest}} ==Patch changes== * {{Patch|1.18.0|note=Added.}}
